info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Careers Applications Feedbacks-v1-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Feedback API allows organizations to access and review feedback associated with job applications. By retrieving feedback data, businesses can gain insights into candidate experiences and improve their hiring processes. This API primarily serves recruiters and HR professionals interested in enhancing their recruitment strategies with actionable data. Typical use cases include analyzing trends in applicant feedback and employing the information to refine future job postings or interview techniques.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch user feedback related to various applications. It provides insights into user experiences and can help improve application functionalities based on user input.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to send feedback related to applications. It should contain relevant information that will help in processing the user's feedback effectively.
